How to update POPtoons Eye

About two minutes. You need a computer with Chrome or Edge and a USB-C data cable.

Most people

Update

Pick Update in the flasher. Only the program is replaced, everything else on the device stays as it is.

New or stuck device

Install fresh

Pick New POPtoons. This erases the device first, then installs everything.

Step by step

  1. Plug in POPtoons Eye

    Use a USB-C cable that carries data, not a charge-only one.

  2. Open the flasher

    Go to the USB flasher in Chrome or Edge on a computer. Safari and Firefox cannot do this.

  3. Press Connect

    Choose the port of the device in the pop-up (an ESP32-S3 / USB JTAG serial port). Not listed? Hold BOOT while you plug in the cable, then try again.

  4. Choose Update

    Keep Update selected to keep the device as it is. Pick New POPtoons only for a fresh start.

  5. Press Flash

    Wait for the bar to reach 100%. Do not unplug the cable.

  6. Done

    The device restarts by itself. Unplug and play.

Every update is checked. The flasher compares the checksum (and the signature, when one is published) before it writes anything, and blocks the update if something is off.

3D case: the eye keychain

A black 3D-printed holder with the round hanger on top. The cased board slides in from the back and the lid clicks shut.

Made for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75-B, the version that already comes with its protective case (51.0 mm round, 12.1 mm thick). The cased unit clicks into the keychain case from the back and the lid snaps shut behind it. Hold it with the hanger up: the USB-C port is at the bottom behind a small slot, the two buttons are at the top, each behind its own round hole. The rest of the wall stays closed. The hole positions are estimated from a photo, so check them on a test print.

Print in black, case with the screen opening down on the bed, lid flat, no supports. The key ring goes through the hole in the middle of the eye. Not test-printed yet: print the case alone first to check the fit.

Files: the STL files (case and lid) and the script that makes them come from BitPopArt, ask for the zip.

Versions

The newest version is installed by default. Older ones are in the flasher too.

FAQ

My computer does not see the device

Try another USB-C cable (it must carry data), hold BOOT while plugging in, and use Chrome or Edge.

Do I lose anything with an update?

Not with Update, only the program is replaced. With New POPtoons the device is erased first.

Can I use Safari, Firefox or a phone?

No. Flashing over USB needs Web Serial, which only Chrome and Edge on a computer have.

The update failed halfway

Unplug, hold BOOT, plug in again and run the flasher with New POPtoons. This always recovers the device.
